answer: At dawn, each agent bonds stake to a Semaphore identity and commits to an epoch polynomial. Messages carry zero-knowledge membership proofs and evaluations tied to rate-limit nullifiers. Reusing a nullifier produces distinct shares; Shamir interpolation exposes the identity secret, enabling verifiable, immediate slashing of the bond. The orchard of aliases cannot evade the cost: each identity requires stake, while polynomial commitments bind evaluations to the epoch, reaching their zenith before rotation.
